claims.claim: The whole process (discord.py + FastAPI in one Python process) should use roughly 80–150 MB, well within 512 MB
claims.measured: python-fastapi alone: 40 MB idle, 41–47 MB peak; discord.py not measured
claims.why: Only the FastAPI half was measured, at about 41–47 MB; discord.py's gateway connection and caches were not measured, so the total for the combined process can't be checked.

claims.measured: 2 MB idle, 7–16 MB peak across all tests
claims.why: The Go servers are among the lightest measured, at 2 MB idle and 16 MB or less at peak.

claims.claim: Java/Spring is heavy on memory for 512 MB
claims.measured: 131–134 MB idle; 209–500 MB peak (java-spring reached 491–500 MB in the I/O and database tests)
claims.why: Spring Boot had the largest footprint measured and came close to the 512 MB limit under load.

claims.claim: .NET is heavy on memory for 512 MB
claims.why: ASP.NET Core used 62 MB at most, about an eighth of 512 MB and less than Node or Rails, so calling it heavy points the wrong way.
